data.name: Sharper Tarkov Better Life
data.teaser: A simple and lightweight ReShade preset that improves visibility and enhances the overall look of EFT by making the game sharper without over-sharpening it or making UI elements an eyesore to look at.
data.description:
Hey! This is NOT A MOD. This is a ReShade preset, meaning this is compatible with all versions of SPT/EFT.

Drag and drop the contents of the SharperTarkovBetterLife.7z file into your root game folder so that dxgi.dll is in the same directory as EscapeFromTarkov.exe.

If you wish to uninstall, delete the files that are added by this preset.

You do not need any mods such as Amand’s Graphics to use this preset, However, it is highly recommended. I wouldn’t recommend using any other methods of sharpening such as any present in EFT’s settings and so on. This doesn’t reduce performance unless you are GPU bottlenecked.

ReShade 6.5.1.2008 is PREINSTALLED. Press HOME to open the overlay menu.

versions.description:
added licensing. im already not exactly following reshade's wishes by shipping shader files and the .dll directly but i want to reduce friction as much as possible so figured licensing and so on should be enough since MIT and BSD3 clause :3

again, no need to update. just making sure everything is semi-ok

moved to github, made some config files less "finished" so it makes you go through tutorial

dont need to update if youre currently using 1.1.1, nothing has changed.

**- Added CAS** shader.

\- **Removed** **Deblur** shader.

\- **Removed** **Zenteon\_Sharpen** shader.

\- **Removed** effect toggle key. (again)  
\- **Changed** amount of samples in **Unsharp** shader.

 **Updating** from 1.0.1/1.0.0? **Drag and drop this update on your SPT install** and then **delete** these directories:"**SPT\\reshade-shaders\\Shaders\\DrawText.fxh**", "**SPT\\reshade-shaders\\Shaders\\Deblur.fx**"**,**"**SPT\\reshade-shaders\\Shaders\\ZenteonFX**"

\- **Removed** unnecessary header file. Doesn't really affect anything but figured its good practice.  
\- **Removed** effect toggle key. Add this in manually via the overlay menu.  
\- **Changed** overlay menu key to **HOME**.

\- **Changed** texture search path to proper directory. Doesn't really affect anything but figured its good practice.

**Updating** from 1.0.0? **Drag and drop this update on your SPT install** and then **delete** this file: "**SPT\\reshade-shaders\\Shaders\\DrawText.fxh**"
